covers: The four registers of the Motorola 6821 PIA, selected by address bits 0 and 1

entries.name: port A data or DDR A
entries.description: Reads the port A pins or the port A direction register.
entries.behaviour: Control A bit 2 set reads port A data, clear reads DDR A (1 = output) with no side effect. Data gives the output register on output bits and the pin on input bits, and clears both CA flags. With CA2 as read strobe (bit 5 set, bit 4 clear) it goes low; bit 3 set raises it at once.

entries.name: port A data or DDR A
entries.description: Writes the port A output register or the port A direction register.
entries.behaviour: Control A bit 2 set writes the output register, clear writes DDR A (1 = output). Each write passes the output handler the output register on output bits and the pin level on input bits; a DDR write does so only if the value changed. Port A writes start no CA2 handshake.

entries.name: control A
entries.description: Reads the control and flag bits of port A.
entries.behaviour: Bits 0 to 5 return as written; bit 7 is the CA1 flag, bit 6 the CA2 flag (while CA2 is an input). The read samples the CA1 and CA2 input callbacks first, which can set a flag, and clears none. IRQA is high while flag 1 and bit 0, or flag 2 and bit 3, are both set.

entries.name: control A
entries.description: Sets the CA1 and CA2 modes and the register select of port A.
entries.behaviour: CA1: bit 0 IRQ enable, bit 1 edge (1 rising). Bit 2 selects data (1) or DDR (0). CA2 is input if bit 5 clear (bit 3 IRQ enable, bit 4 edge); else output: bit 4 set follows bit 3, bit 4 clear is read strobe (bit 3 set: high at once, clear: on a CA1 edge).

entries.name: port B data or DDR B
entries.description: Reads the port B pins or the port B direction register.
entries.behaviour: Control B bit 2 set reads port B data, clear reads DDR B (1 = output). Data gives the output register on output bits and the pin on input bits (0 with no input handler), and clears both CB flags. With CB2 in write strobe (bit 4 clear), bit 3 clear and the CB1 flag set, CB2 goes high.

entries.name: port B data or DDR B
entries.description: Writes the port B output register or the port B direction register.
entries.behaviour: Control B bit 2 set writes the output register, clear writes DDR B (1 = output). The handler gets output-register bits on output pins, the tri-state value (else 0) on input pins, and DDR; a DDR write calls it if changed. In write strobe (bit 4 clear) a data write pulls CB2 low; bit 3 set raises it at once.

entries.name: control B
entries.description: Reads the control and flag bits of port B.
entries.behaviour: Bits 0 to 5 return as written; bit 7 is the CB1 flag, bit 6 the CB2 flag (while CB2 is an input). The read samples the CB1 input callback first, which can set a flag, and clears none. IRQB is high while flag 1 and bit 0, or flag 2 and bit 3, are both set.

entries.name: control B
entries.description: Sets the CB1 and CB2 modes and the register select of port B.
entries.behaviour: CB1: bit 0 IRQ enable, bit 1 edge (1 rising). Bit 2 selects data (1) or DDR (0). CB2 is input if bit 5 clear (bit 3 IRQ enable, bit 4 edge); else output: bit 4 set follows bit 3, bit 4 clear is write strobe (bit 3 set: high at once, clear: at port B read after CB1 edge).
